observations: Portable source port only: original ordinary return declarations remain unresolved (provisional void); all three identities compiled declaration-pending. No ARM ABI, GUI inheritance, original object layout or hardware interoperability claim.

Explicit semantic conversion: native [type,gain,Q,frequency,enabled,extra] -> portable [slot3,gain,q,frequency,slot4,slot5]. Existing positional contains/zeroParam are deliberately unchanged; legacy positional helper users must continue their explicit conversion.

Stable count, valid allocated memory, borrowed parameters and owner survive synchronous operations. Provider add/remove do not reenter/resize or mutate bindings; allocation failure, concurrent mutations, partial bindings excluded. setBand throws before effects on incomplete portable bindings, a source-port guard outside native equivalence domain.

Native oracle executes application instruction ranges and stubs only the external CCL Parameter add/remove boundaries; no Core binary reconstruction. Compiled replay transparently wraps calls to real pinned CCL providers, inspects actual observerList membership and calls changed() through real EQ portableObserver adapter.

Null owner is forwarded as null to provider add/remove and inspected for membership, but never notified: CCL signal requires nonnull observer. No original observer null-notification semantics claimed.

Native PC/write guards restrict execution to exact three bodies and explicit provider boundaries, stack writes and selected band/dirty writes. Portable memory layout is not compared byte-for-byte; semantic state and phase snapshots are exact.
